title: Slip Coding.pdf — page 26
text:
Site Deductibles
• Site deductibles are deductibles that apply to a whole location, 
independent of coverage type (CV1, CV2, CV3).
• Site deductibles are entered in the _SITEDED column in the loc file for a 
given peril (EQSITEDED, WSSITEDED etc).
• Monetary values or % deductibles can be entered here (% in decimal 
format).
• Filter for your selected criteria (e.g. California) and apply relevant 
deductible for that peril.
• Site deductibles can be viewed within RiskLink in the Secondary 
Modifier tabs in the loc table for each location.
